In the case where a dominant opening is likely to occur during a severe storm, the total
pressure on walls and roofs of an enclosed building should be determined with the aid
of other published materials acceptable to the Building Authority or through the use of
wind tunnel model studies.

Example calculations of pressure coefficients and total force acting on individual
elements of enclosed buildings are given in the calculation sheets A4 and AS in
Appendix A.
